title: AI Models Favor Different Political Parties in Study
excerpt: A new study reveals that Grok overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates, while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats.
body_html:
A recent study highlights distinct political leanings between different artificial intelligence models when forced to choose candidates in upcoming elections. According to the research, Grok's AI model overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates. In contrast, OpenAI's model shows a preference for Democrats.

The evaluation examined nearly 500 election races. The findings indicate that the two AI systems disagreed with each other in more than 90 percent of the evaluated contests. The study points to significant differences in how major language models process political choices and provide recommendations for voters.
